full_track.tags: K-Pop R&B ballad. Clean electric guitar plays a jazz-influenced progression with seventh chords and subtle vibrato. A fretless electric bass performs melodic slides and syncopated fills. The drum kit features a dry, tight snare and a soft kick drum. Male vocals transition between a breathy chest voice and a light falsetto. The arrangement uses a Rhodes piano for harmonic padding. Key of E Major, 78 BPM. 4/4 time signature. The production is clean with moderate plate reverb on the vocals and guitar.
